text: Summoner's Prowess is a Demonology warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Breath of Thal'kiel, Imp-erator (artifact trait), and The Doom of Azeroth traits.
Summon Royal Guard is sometimes obtained when Lady S'theno completes Class Hall missions‎. Using the item, lets a Coilskar Brute acompany your Class Hall followers.
Sumptuous Cowl is created with Draenor Tailoring (1); taught by Draenor Tailoring (item).
Sumptuous Leggings are created with Draenor Tailoring (1); taught by Draenor Tailoring (item).
Sumptuous Robes are created with Draenor Tailoring (1); taught by Draenor Tailoring (item).
Summon Dawnforge Ram is a type of ram used by a dwarf paladin as a mount. It is learned automatically at level 20, and increases movement speed by 60%.
Summon Darkforge Ram is a type of ram used by Dark Iron dwarf paladins as a mount. It is learned automatically at level 20.
Summoned Zombies are zombies summoned by Dark Summoners in Eastern Plaguelands.
Summon Demonic Tyrant is a Demonology warlock talent that summons a Demonic Tyrant. It attacks with Demonfire.
Summoner Siavass is a naga located in the Sundered Temple in Zuldazar.
The Sun-Worn Chest will appear on top of the device on the balcony of High Sage Viryx in Skyreach after the puzzle has been solved.
Sun-Parched Waterskins are sold most commonly by innkeepers in Vol'dun.
__NOTOC__ Summoner Yarz is a blood troll located at Torga's Rest in Nazmir.
Sun-Turned Curds is sold by Rhan'ka in Vol'dun in stacks of five for .
Summer Gift Package was the quest reward from Redeem iCoke Gift Box Voucher.

.]] .]]__NOTOC__ Summoning Platform is a location of the Dreadscar Rift where the warlock leader of the Council of the Black Harvest goes in Summoning the Sisters to enslave the Eredar Twins and in The Wrathsteed of Xoroth to acquire a Wrathsteed mount.
Sunburst Crest drops from Frida Ironbellows for the Horde and Ra'wani Kanae for the Alliance in the Battle of Dazar'alor.
Sun Totems are totems summoned by Sunwalker Champion in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Sunbeaten Oasis Band is a quest reward from The Great Cranium Caper.
Piles of Sun Baked Dung are located in the Brine Basin in Vol'dun during Foul Harvest.
__NOTOC__ Sundered Cravens are Zandalari troll ghosts located in Nazmir. They are being corrupted by Corrupted Vessels which make them cry or cower in fear.
Summon Vilefiend is a demonology warlock talent that summons a vilefiend to fight for you for 15 seconds. It is an exclusive choice node with Soul Strike.
Sun King Nahkotep is a tol'vir located at the Tomb of the Sun King in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum. He is the leader of the Amathet.
Sun King's Decree drops from the following tol'vir in Uldum: *Amathet Suntouched *Suntouched Acolyte *Suntouched Ritualist
Sun Priestess Nubitt is a tol'vir located at the Cursed Landing in Uldum during the assault in Uldum.
Sun Prophet Epaphos is a tol'vir located in Uldum during the assault in Uldum.
Summit Zephyr is sold by Barry in Stormsong Valley for 15x Thin Jelly.

Sun Prophet Tenhamen is a tol'vir located in the Vault of Lights in the Halls of Origination during The Halls of Origination. Once weakened, he will reveal his true form, Shith'rus the Manipulator, a n'raqi.
Summoned Imps are imps summoned by Rok'nah Felcasters in Theramore's Fall.
__NOTOC__ Sunbleached Reefwalkers are coral ancients located in Nazjatar.
Summoned Eyes are located in the Repository in the Mogu'shan Vaults. They have been summoned by Deephive Summoners.
Summoned Maws are located in the Repository in the Mogu'shan Vaults. They have been summoned by Deephive Summoners.
Summoned Tentacles are tentacles located in the Repository in the Mogu'shan Vaults. They have been summoned by Deephive Summoners.
The Sun Forge was a planned subzone on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
Summoned Lobstrok is a makrura guardian summoned by Darktide Summoner Staff.
Summoner Ta'xach is a broker located at Transfer Station Ta in Bastion.
Summerflies are glimmerflies located at the Small Shrine in Bastion.
Sun King's Salvation is an encounter located in Castle Nathria.
The Summons of the Chosen are provided as an objective for A Common Peril.
Summons from the Depths is a scenario event occurring in Nazjatar.
The Summoned Wardrobe was to summoned by the Emergency Wardrobe Kit and would allow for transmogrification on the go.
The Summoned Arachnid is a spider located in the Hall of Curiosities in Oribos. It appears through a portal, and Stablehand Ta'shno will stable it in the Dimensional Storage Cube.
The Summoner's Granite Gavel drops from Novos the Summoner at Scourgeholme in Icecrown during Death Rising.
Sun-Touched Flutterwings are moths located throughout the Valley of the Four Winds and in the Townlong Steppes.
Summoner Gerard is a lich located at the Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus. He summons Visectus to attack the Blackhound Outpost, allowing players to access the Blackhound Cache.
Summoned Creatures are bears and zhevra summoned by Stablehand Ta'shno and Keeper Ta'saran in Oribos.
Summoned Maldraxxian Wildlife are oozelings and bloodtusks summoned by Stablehand Ta'shno and Keeper Ta'saran in Oribos.
Summoned Runestag is a runestag summoned by Stablehand Ta'shno and Keeper Ta'saran in Oribos.
Summon Feral Shadehound is provided for Feral Shadehound (quest) as part of the long chain to acquire the Bound Shadehound mount. Using it summons Feral Shadehound, a temporary vehicle mount.

Summoned Glimmerhoof Cloudstrider is a cloudstrider summoned by Stablehand Ta'shno and Keeper Ta'saran in Oribos. After they comment on it, Stablehand Ta'shno takes it to a "storage" box in the next room.
Summoned Boggarts are boggarts located in the Distant Grotto in Ardenweald.
Summon Champion was one of the unimplemented priest's champion spells discovered during beta.

Summer Wilderling Harness is rewarded from Wilderling Saddle, started from the rarely-dropped Wilderling Saddle (item) from the Escaped Wilderling vignette on Hope's Ascent in western Korthia. Only Night Fae Covenant players will ever see the Wilderling Saddle drop.
Summoned Felhunter is a felhound summoned by the warlock adventurer at Strahad Farsan's tower above Ratchet in the Barrens during The Binding (Felhunter).
Sunblood Amethyst drops from High Adjudicator Aleez in the Halls of Atonement.
Sun Gliders were wind serpents located on Windward Isle in the Jade Forest.
Sun Trinkets are summoned by Adepts of the Dawn and Initiates of the Rising Sun in Skyreach.
Sun Charged Guardian is a Apexis guardians located in the Spires of Arak.
The Summer Cranial Skillet can be purchased from Midsummer Suppliers and Midsummer Merchants during Midsummer Fire Festival for .
Summon Lightforged Ruinstrider is a type of talbuk used by Lightforged draenei paladins as a mount. It is learned automatically at level 20.
Summoned Blackhand Dreadweavers are orcs summoned by Blackhand Summoners in Upper Blackrock Spire.
Summoned Blackhand Veterans are orcs summoned by Blackhand Summoners in Upper Blackrock Spire.
Sunbathed Avian Armor drops from Garudeon at Garudeon's Nest in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Sun-Baked Linens are looted from Handwoven Basket in Thaldraszus.
Sundered Onyx Loupe is profession accessory for Jewelcrafting created with Dragon Isles Jewelcrafting); taught by Design: Sundered Onyx Loupes.
__NOTOC__ Sundered Onyx is a raw gem from Prospecting used in several Dragon Isles jewelcrafting designs.
__NOTOC__ Sundered Enforcers are drakonid located in Nelthazan Ruins in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Summoned Lava Elementals are lava elementals located in Obsidian Citadel and Dragonbane Keep in the Waking Shores, summoned by Djaradin Flametamers, Dragonbane Firebinders, and Pirdan The Blinder.
__NOTOC__ Sundered Runebinders are dracthyr located in the Nelthazan Ruins in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Summon Soulkeeper is a warlock class talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Inquisitor's Gaze.

The Summer Bowl was the first esports tournament for World of Warcraft: Classic. It was introduced on 8 June 2020 and took place over three weeks starting on June 17 the same year. It had a prize pool of $8,000 (USD) with it being split between the North America and Europe regions. Using the War Game feature, the tournament places 20 players in a 10v10 Warsong Gulch battle.
__NOTOC__ Sundered Flame Journal is found inside the Lost Ruins in the Azure Span.

Sundered Flame Expedition Notes drop from Sundered defenders, menders, and researchers at the Sundered Flame Camp in Zaralek Cavern. Scalecommander Emberthal wants six of them in Collating Their Research, part of the Embers of Neltharion campaign.

Sundered Scaleguards are green dragonspawn located at the Blazing Bulwark in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.

Sundered Flame Camp is, perhaps predicted by the name, where the Sundered Flame have set up camp in southeastern Zaralek Cavern, a stone's throw from Nal ks'kol. Players visit the area during chapter two of the Embers of Neltharion campaign on the quests Save-A-Mole and Collating Their Research. The camp is bordered by Nal ks'kol to the east, the Crystal Fields to the north, and the Fanged Pasture to the west. Alcanon spawns in a small cave immediately to the west of the camp. The camp is also occupied by Sundered defenders, menders, and researchers.
Sunbleached Grimskull Cinch was available for purchase from the Trading Post in May 2023 for 100 Trader's Tender.

Sundered Ambushers are dracthyr located at the Lost Atheneum in the Forbidden Reach. Many are found dead during Creche Fallen, making it obvious that the Scalecommander Emberthal's talons did not go down without a fight.
Sundered Flame Cleavers are black dragonspawn who patrol the Sulfur Wastes alongside Sundered Flame Brawlers, Sundered Flame Flamespinners, and Sundered Flame Manaweavers in Zaralek Cavern.
Sundered Flame Manaweavers are blue dragonspawn who patrol the Sulfur Wastes alongside Sundered Flame Brawlers, Sundered Flame Cleavers, and Sundered Flame Flamespinners, in Zaralek Cavern.
Sundered Flame Flamespinners are dracthyr who patrol the Sulfur Wastes alongside Sundered Flame Brawlers, Sundered Flame Cleavers, and Sundered Flame Manaweavers in Zaralek Cavern.
Sundered Flame Brawlers are blue drakonid who patrol the Sulfur Wastes alongside Sundered Flame Cleavers, Sundered Flame Flamespinners, and Sundered Flame Manaweavers in Zaralek Cavern.
Sundered Flames Expedition Orders drops from Sundered Sentinel, Arcane Manipulator and Tarasek Warrior in the Azure Span.
Sundered Chemists are black dragonspawn located in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Sunblossom Pollen is looted from Sunblossoms in the Dreamgrove.
Sundered Shadetalons are dracthyr located in Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores and in Thaldraszus.
Sundered Shackles Key is found in the Lonely Falls in the Azure Span.
__NOTOC__ Sungrass is a Herb that can be gathered with Herbalism (230).

Sunnyglade was a town in the kingdom of Stormwind at the time of the First War. It was known for its wealth and prosperity. With the fall of the kingdom at the end of the First War, it is assumed the town was deserted, occupied, or razed completely.

Sundown Marsh, located to the northwest, is the deepest part of the Wetlands and where an odd couple make their home. Fradd Swiftgear and Wenna Silkbeard live here in a small stone dwelling with a windmill, called Swiftgear Station. They sell peculiar items they come across in the marsh, and also some uncommon recipes. The swampland on all sides are full of aggressive crocolisks, gnolls, raptors, bog beasts, and oozes, which discourages inexperienced adventurers from approaching.
Sunscale Screechers are raptors native to the Northern Barrens. When at low health, it screeches for help, attracting others of its kind to assist bringing down its attacker.
Sunscale Scytheclaws are level 16-18 raptors native to the Northern Barrens.

Sunsail Anchorage is a shipyard located in western Eversong Woods, west of Saltheril's Haven and north of Goldenbough Pass. It has been completely taken over by the Wretched. At least one of the ships sunk in the Sunsail Anchorage is a pirate vessel. Some other ships dated back to the Second War. During the Year 25 and after the formation of the Blood Knights, Lady Liadrin led here her team consisting of Cyssa Dawnrose, Mehlar Dawnblade, Bloodvalor, Solanar Bloodwrath, Vranesh and Bachi. A tall, three-story building is the only structure at the Anchorage. In the center of the second story is a golden orb with an arm extending through the side of the building, through a slanted opening that c

Sunfury Hold is a blood elf encampment in southern Netherstorm ruled by one of Kael'thas' lieutenants, Spellreaver Marathelle. These blood elves are responsible for the destruction of the Kirin'Var Village.

Sunrock Cove is a famous getaway for those rich enough to explore its vast area. Heroes are reminded to tip zeppelin operators after they are transported to this gold-laden retreat.[http://www.battle.net/war3/maps/war3xbonusmaps4.shtml]

Sunscale Lashtails are raptors found in the Northern Barrens. Deceased Sunscale Lashtails are located in Razorfen Kraul. Some of them were completely skinned and their skeleton hung. They were also seen during the Legion Invasions of the Barrens.
The Sunfury Bow of the Phoenix drops from Prince Malchezaar in Karazhan.

Sunfury Signets are carried by high-ranking followers of Kael'thas, although Illidari blood elves carry them as well. They can be collected and turned in to Scryers for reputation. Each item gives 25 reputation all the way up to exalted. The Aldor equivalent is the Mark of Sargeras.
Sunstrider's Longbow is an ancient elven artifact, now wielded by Sylvanas Windrunner.
Sunstrider's Gauntlets are a quest reward from WANTED: Blacktalon the Savage.

Sunstrider Book Satchel is provided when player accepts Solanian's Belongings.

The Sunhawks are a group of blood elves loyal to Kael'thas Sunstrider who commandeered the Exodar before the draenei, led by Velen, stole it back. A small group of them were led by Sironas in Bloodmyst Isle. Among her plans, Sironas had begun using the remains of the ship's Vector Coil to create a Sun Gate, a dimensional rift which allowed for a steady supply of reinforcements to be shipped from Outland. They wished to reclaim the Exodar and seemed to want to turn the draenei into man'ari eredar. They have since been disbanded by adventurers sent by the Hand of Argus.
__NOTOC__ Sunseeker Botanists are blood elves found in the Botanica. It appears that each botanist is accompanied by a Greater Frayer.

Sunhawk Reclaimers are blood elves located at the Cryo-Core on Bloodmyst Isle.

Sunstrider Warboots are epic plate boots for Retribution Paladins and DPS Warriors, that drops from Kael'thas Sunstrider in Magisters' Terrace.
Sunrage Shoulderpads used to drop from Kael'thas Sunstrider in Magisters' Terrace on Normal mode. However, they were replaced with Sunrage Treads.
Sunrage Treads are epic leather boots that drop from Kael'thas Sunstrider in Magisters' Terrace.
The Sunfire Robe is a BoP tailor crafted robe introduced in patch 2.4. From then until the release of Wrath of the Lich King, this was the best caster robe in the game.
Sunscale Feathers drop from the following raptors in the Northern Barrens: *Sunscale Lashtail *Sunscale Screecher *Sunscale Scytheclaw
The Sunhawk Portal Controller is located in the Bloodmyst Isle.
__NOTOC__ Sunfury Arch Mages can be found around Manaforge Coruu in Netherstorm.
__NOTOC__ Sunfury Nethermancers are found near Manaforge Ara in the Netherstorm.
Sunreaver Scouts are blood elf guards for the Sunreaver's Command in the Crystalsong Forest.
Sunreaver Hawkstriders are blood elf guards that patrol the road leading to the Sunreaver's Command in Crystalsong Forest.

Sunreaver's Command is a Sunreaver outpost opposite to Windrunner's Overlook north of the Unbound Thicket in northeast Crystalsong Forest. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard reported that while most of the Sunreavers remained with Dalaran as it moved, Sunreaver's Command is still their outpost in Northrend.
The Sunseekers are a military unit of blood elves fiercely loyal to Kael'thas Sunstrider. They are established in Tempest Keep and its various wings (particularly the Botanica and the Mechanar).

.]] Sunreaver Guardians are blood elf guards located around the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. Unlike the Silver Covenant Guardians, they appear to be exclusively male. They were present during Death Rising.

The Sunreaver Pavilion is located in the southeastern portion of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. It is the Horde's base of operations for the Argent Tournament, staffed by representatives of each playable race of WotLK in the Horde as well as The Sunreavers.

The Sunken Ring is an area in eastern Wintergrasp. It houses the north easternmost Goblin Workshop, where siege weapons can be built. At the beginning of the battle, this workshop is in control of the defending force.
Sunken Temple is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the final boss of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar instance.
The Sunglimmer Drape is a quest reward from All Is Well That Ends Well.

The Sunstrider's Regalia set is the Tier 9 Horde Mage raid set. It is composed of any items from these sub-sets: * Conqueror's Sunstrider's Regalia (ilevel 232) *:purchased with Justice Points * Triumphant Sunstrider's Regalia (ilevel 245) *: purchased with Justice Points and Trophy of the Crusade, from Trial of the Crusader * Triumphant Sunstrider's Regalia (heroic) (ilevel 258) *: purchased with Regalia of the Grand Vanquisher, from Trial of the Grand Crusader

The Sunreaver Tabard can be purchased for from Vasarin Redmorn at the Sunreaver Pavilion in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown by players who have completed . Dawnseeker Guardians of the Sunreaver Onslaught and Nadina Stargem wear these tabards.
Sunseeker Netherbinders are blood elves found in the Mechanar.
Sunreaver Orders drop from Sunreaver Agent in the Underbelly of Dalaran.

__NOTOC__ The Sunreaver Agent is a blood elf found in the Underbelly sewers of Dalaran. During the Purge of Dalaran, an agent can found in his or her usual place at the Black Market, where they will be fed to Segacedi the sewer shark by Sorin Magehand.
__NOTOC__ Sunfury Astromancers are found near Manaforge B'naar in the Netherstorm.

Sunfury Technicians are found in Manaforge B'naar, Manaforge Coruu and Manaforge Duro in the Netherstorm. They are trying to get the forges back online during the following quests: *Shutting Down Manaforge B'naar (Aldor) / Shutting Down Manaforge B'naar (Scryers) *Shutting Down Manaforge Coruu (Aldor) / Shutting Down Manaforge Coruu (Scryers) *Shutting Down Manaforge Duro (Aldor) / Shutting Down Manaforge Duro (Scryers)

Sunfury Protectors are found in Manaforge Duro in the Netherstorm. They are trying to get the forge back online during the following quest: *Shutting Down Manaforge Duro (Aldor) / Shutting Down Manaforge Duro (Scryers)
__NOTOC__ Sunfury Guardsmen are found near Manaforge Coruu in the Netherstorm.
__NOTOC__ Sunfury Captains are blood elves found near Manaforge B'naar in the Netherstorm.
__NOTOC__ Sunfury Blood Knights are found near Manaforge Ara in the Netherstorm.
Sunhawk Spies are blood elves found in Bladewood on Bloodmyst Isle.
Sunken Cargo is a quest item for Nerve Tonic, the cargo contains Mack's Deep Sea Grog for Mack Fearsen.

Sunreaver Hawkriders are blood elf sentries atop hawkstriders, found patrolling through Sunreaver's Command. Currently, the hawkriders use Sunreaver Hawkstriders, though were previously seen atop Swift White Hawkstriders.
Sunscale Cloak is a quest reward from Into the Raptor's Den.
Sunken Treasure Chests are located in the north-eastern parts of the Shimmering Deep in Thousand Needles.

Sunstone Terrace is a tomb overlooking the Steps of Fate in Uldum. The terrace is covered with Crazed Diggers, commanded by Mekgineer Mixeltweed, trying to gain entrance into the vault. Sunstone Terrace and the nearby areas were once the territory of the Amathet, though at some point they ventured into tombs beneath the dunes. They were awakened when Sargeras struck Azeroth.

Sunstorm watched Nuji Kodosbreath attacking a camp of trolls and orc raiders. Nuji's forces ended up catching sixty orc prisoners for interrogation. The assembly wasn't to happy about how Sunstorm's men killed all the orcs in the last raid.
The Sunken Temple Digsite occupies about half of the Pool of Tears. It runs from the Temple of Atal'Hakkar to the shore in a semi-circle around the entrance. It is a troll archaeology dig site.
Sunreaver War Mages are blood elves found alongside Myralion Sunblaze within Icecrown.
Sunflowers are small plant creatures capable of absorbing sunlight and focusing solar beam attacks. They were first introduced in Cataclysm and are classified as elementals in-game.
Sunken Temple Guild Run is an achievement that is awarded for defeating the final boss of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar while in a guild group.

The Sunsoaked Meadow is a field of marigolds found just north of Mudmug's Place in the Valley of the Four Winds. The Twitchheel virmen live in this meadow and the Twisted Warren beneath it. The brood's alpha males (Jinanya, Frenzyhop, and Aiyu) are found throughout the meadow.

Sunsong Ranch is a farmstead found in western Halfhill, in central Valley of the Four Winds. Inherited by Farmer Yoon, helping him out will give the player access to his farm and a place to grow their own cooking ingredients via phasing.

__NOTOC__ Sungraze Mushan are mushan patroling at the Rumbling Terrace and Winds' Edge, around Silken Fields, and north of Stormstout Brewery in the Valley of the Four Winds. Some are found dead, being devoured by the longfang wolves as well as Wildscale Hunters and Poachers.
Sunni is a pandaren located at Zhu's Watch in Krasarang Wilds.

Sungshin Ironpaw is a teacher of Pandaren cooking at the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds. She starts the quests to learn the six Ways, which are needed to raise cooking skill to 600. She also appears in the quests and the Finding the Secret Ingredient scenario which lead to Pandaren Treasure Noodle Cart Kit. The rice pudding recipe is her favorite. She traveled to Valdrakken and can be found at the Ruby Feast on Tuesdays. On the nearby table, Azerothian Spices and Halfhill Account Records can be found. On her buffet table, one may find Fried Emperor Wraps, Seared Sea Mist Noodles, and Roquerfort-Stuffed Peppers.
Sunrise Cranes are cranes located in the Woods of the Lost and near Camp Nooka Nooka in the Jade Forest.

The Sunset Brewgarden can be found immediately southeast of the Dusklight Bridge on the northern border of Dread Wastes from Townlong Steppes. Nestled in an unnamed kypari tree, the Amber Vault can also be found inside, accessed via the south side of the tree on the Horrid March. Just west, immediately south of the Dusklight bridge, is Kor'vess.
Sunke Khang is the mayor of Paw'don Village, a pandaren village in Jade Forest allied with the Alliance.
Sunkissed Wine is an alcoholic drink that rarely drops from Neferset Enforcers during Neferset Prison in Uldum. It is also rarely looted from the Blingtron 4000 Gift Package.

__NOTOC__ Sunreaver Mages are blood elven magi who attempted to protect the Sunreaver's Sanctuary during the Purge of Dalaran. After the Sanctuary was overrun, they (along with several Sunreaver Aegis) retreated to the center of Dalaran, a position they held with the support of Grand Magister Rommath.

__NOTOC__ Sunreaver Summoners are blood elven magi that attempted to hold the Sunreaver's Sanctuary during the Purge of Dalaran. Like their Frosthand counterparts encountered in the sewers below, they specialize in frost damage.
__NOTOC__ Sunreaver Aegis are blood elf paladins living in Dalaran. They are seen during the purge of Dalaran and aid the Sunreaver citizens that have come under attack.
__NOTOC__ Sunreaver Captains are blood elves found in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary during the Purge of Dalaran. They also accompanied the Horde on the Isle of Thunder.

__NOTOC__ Sunreaver Duelists are blood elven combatants belonging to the Sunreaver organization. They are encountered in both the Horde and Alliance versions of the Purge of Dalaran, fighting off Silver Covenant members in the former, and facing off with Alliance agents in the latter.
__NOTOC__ Sunreaver Assassins are blood elf rogues living in Dalaran. They are found in the Dalaran Sewers. They later assisted the Horde on the Isle of Thunder.

Sunreaver Citizens are members of the Kirin Tor's blood elven wing, the Sunreavers. They can be found in the Underbelly during the Purge of Dalaran. They also appear above ground and in the Circle of Wills.
The Sunken Crate is a crate located at the Kelp'thar Forest, it was previously a ship's cargo. It is filled with crab meat.
The Sunreaver Bounty is a quest reward from boss-killing daily quests on the Isle of Thunder for the Sunreaver Onslaught.

__NOTOC__ The Sunreaver Micro-Sentry is a rare drop (about a 20% chance) from the Haywire Sunreaver Construct, one of the Champions of Lei Shen, found on the beach of Ihgaluk Crag on the southeastern corner of the Isle of Thunder.
Sunreaver Constructs are arcane golems found at Wildvine Marsh or Dawnseeker Promontory of Isle of Thunder.

Sunreaver Mana Wyrms are mana wyrms located around Dawnseeker Promontory. They are considerably more dangerous than previously encountered breeds of mana wyrm, and specialize in fighting spellcasters, as many Kirin Tor magi have learned to their peril. They are in groups of 2-3 guarding Sunreaver Mana Collectors.
The Sunset Silk Robe is a quest reward from Falling to Pieces.

Sunreaver Servants are the workers with the Sunreaver Onslaught building helping to construct the Dawnseeker Promontory on the Isle of Thunder. They will also oversee the work of the arcane golems, who will in turn watch over the cargo haulers. One of the servants is seen killed behind the Promontory's inn.

Sunreaver Spellblades are blood elves found on the Isle of Thunder. They can be seen aiding in Lor'themar Theron's initial assault on the Thunder King's stronghold. They later appeared in Dalaran on top of the Violet Citadel and in the Hall of the Guardian.
Sunreaver Captives are blood elves located in around Violet Rise on the Isle of Thunder.
Sunreaver Onslaught Insignias are purchased in exchange for from Vasarin Redmorn on the Dawnseeker Promontory or Supplier Bao in the Bleak Hollow of the Isle of Thunder.

Sunreaver Refugees are blood elven civilians encountered during the Purge of Dalaran. They can be found in the Circle of Wills hiding and cowering amidst the Silver Covenant and Sunreaver combatants around them. They do not engage in the conflict, but will be randomly attacked by Silver Covenant enforcers not already doing battle.

Sunreaver Sentinels are blood elves seen during the Galakras encounter in the Siege of Orgrimmar.

The Sunken Fishing boat is found at on the bottom of the largest pond in Gloomshade Grove, down at the southwest extent of the area not far from Kuu'rat in northwestern . It contains 5 Parasitic Starfish and 10-20x Garrison Resources.
Sunny is a wolf located at the Southern Isles in the Krasarang Wilds. Sunny is the companion of Lieutenant Ethan Jacobson.

The Sunsworn are a military force of blood elves. Headed by the Blood Knights, they have combined forces with rangers and magi and based themselves in Talador. They have also deployed the blood elves' recently-acquired blood golem technology. They are led by the Blood Knight Matriarch, Lady Liadrin. They serve as the Horde equivalent of the Auchenai.
Sunsworn Camp is a small Blood Knight camp found in southeastern Talador. Its from here Lady Liadrin can sense more of the demonic taint in the area.
The Sunfire Kaliri has a chance to drop from Big Bag of Pet Supplies.
Suniya Greenhoof is a tauren that sometimes visits and wanders in the Frostwall's garrison.
The Sunset Shore is an expansive shore of the South Sea found in southwestern Talador.
Sunsworn Honor Guards are Blood Knights serving the Sunsworn. Some of them were captured by the Sargerei during their assault on .
Sunsworn Rangers are blood elven rangers serving the Sunsworn. It is unknown if it is intended, but they sound like high elves instead.

__NOTOC__ Sunsworn Defenders are elven rangers serving the Sunsworn. A group is found keeping a Frenzied Golem at bay at Liadrin's Watch in Gorgrond. Others, found at the Sunsworn Camp, were injured and poisoned.
Sunreaver Sailor are the the blood elven Sunreavers found aboard ships on the Isle of Thunder.
Sunkeeper Croesus is a tol'vir located at Terror Run in Un'Goro Crater.
Sunspring Post Refugees are Mag'har orcs located in Garadar in Nagrand.

Sunreaver Bloodhawks are dragonhawks located on the Isle of Thunder.
Sunreaver Lieutenants are blood elf paladins located on the Isle of Thunder. They later reappeared in Suramar.

The Sunken Stair connects the Forgotten Approach to the Abyssal Approach. A statue of Queen Azshara similar to Haidene's can be found here, with The Dread Stalker hanging from it. Maiev Shadowsong passed and stopped before the statue of Queen Azshara before meeting Lady Vashj, though that one had a tail and extra arms. It is also where Urluk Cloud-killer was killed by Gul'dan, as a mini-scenario plays where the echo of an unnamed Shadow Council member is killed by an echo of the warlock.

Suns Out, Thori'dals Out is a collections achievement rewarded for collecting the three tier 6 armor set pieces from Sunwell Plateau, bracers, belt, and boots. This counts toward the meta-achievement Azeroth's Next Top Model. The remaining tier 6 pieces drop from Black Temple and Battle for Mount Hyjal, and count toward the Black is the New Black achievement.

Sunspring Villagers are deceased Mag'har orcs located in Sunspring Post in Nagrand. They were killed by the Murkblood tribe, who sacked Sunspring Post and murdered its residents. The Murkblood also began dumping the bodies into the lake, which posed a risk of contaminating the local water supply. Otonbu the Sage tasked an adventurer with burning the bodies before they could rot.
